list.author: Person 22
list.text:
Last week Rid described what our jobs may evolve into as not so much "problem solver" as “problem finder”

I've spent 12 years in a more traditional web design path.
lately I've been building my own products faster by putting on more of a creative director hat. I set the direction, prompt with intention, and explore different agentic workflows until the work gets where I want it to go. The work you and Michael share feels much closer to where I want to be.

What I'm still trying to understand is how to position myself for it. When you meet someone who thinks, explores, and builds this way, what role are you hiring them for? And what would someone with a more traditional title history need to show you to earn that opportunity?
